Scenario: SC-06: Single Confirm does not generate invoice
Precondition: Logged-in seeded customer; fresh cart with one in-stock item; baseline invoice count recorded before checkout
Test Data: Login: customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com (see PrismStructure/.env.example CUSTOMER_PASSWORD) | Product: Combination Pliers qty 1 | Payment: Cash on Delivery | Billing: Zoey Shore Hesselbury Florida TG 1234AA | Baseline: note total invoice count in My Invoices before test
Steps: 1. Login and add Combination Pliers (qty 1) to cart | 2. Complete checkout with COD and billing to /checkout/confirm | 3. Record invoice count in My Invoices (baseline) | 4. Click Confirm button exactly ONCE | 5. Capture screenshot of confirmation screen | 6. Navigate to My Invoices without clicking Confirm again | 7. Compare invoice count to baseline; search for invoice matching current cart
Expected Result: After exactly one Confirm click: invoice ID/number is not fully issued on confirmation screen; My Invoices count is unchanged and no new invoice matches this cart; screenshot evidence captured for execution-evidence/manual/
Risk Covered: P0 single-confirm trap — authoritative negative for assessment double-confirm rule
